**Coaching note:**

Black's king on h8 is trapped on the back rank with no escape squares. When you see a king cornered like this, look for forcing checks that cut off its flight squares. Here, Rxh7+ is a check that forces Kg8 (only legal move), and then Qf7 is mate because the king has no escape squares and the queen controls all of them. Always scan for back-rank weaknesses—they're one of the most common ways club players get mated.
